# Sporting Life fixtures

These files are synthetic parser-contract fixtures. They are not downloaded copies of Sporting
Life pages and do not contain current products, prices, inventory, scripts, tracking data, or
personal information.

All product names, model numbers, prices, and inventory values are fictional test inputs. They must
never be presented as real retailer data. The production adapter remains network-disabled until
the project's permitted data-source strategy is reviewed again.
